scenes.heading: Monitoring
scenes.narration: Monitoring is how you observe your jobs, clusters, and queries so you can catch failures and performance problems early.

scenes.heading: What to watch
bullets: Job run status and duration trends
Cluster metrics like CPU and memory
Query performance and the Spark UI
scenes.narration: Watch job run status and duration trends to spot failures and creeping slowdowns. Cluster metrics such as CPU and memory reveal whether compute is under or over provisioned. And query history plus the Spark UI help you pinpoint slow stages and shuffles.

scenes.heading: Responding to an alert
scenes.narration: When an alert fires on a failed run, you start by opening that run and its logs. From there you diagnose the root cause using the Spark UI to see where time or memory went. Finally you apply a fix and rerun just the affected task rather than the whole pipeline.

scenes.text: Configure failure and SLA alerts on every production job so problems surface before users notice stale data.
scenes.narration: Configure failure and SLA alerts on every production job, so problems surface before your users ever notice stale data.
